userName.description: User name of session owning the statement.

clientAddr.description: Client ip address of statement owner.

clientHostname.description: Client host name of statement owner.

backendStart.description: Time when connection for statement was initiated.

backendElapsedSec.description:
Elapsed time since connection for statement was initiated.  Note that if the statement has already completed or this wasn't the first statement for the connection,
this will be larger than the elapsed time for executing the statement.

xactStart.description: Time when transaction was started for the statement.

xactElapsedSec.description:
Elapsed time since db started executing the statement.  Note that if the statement has already completed or this wasn't the first statement for the transaction,
this will be larger than the elapsed time for executing the statement.

queryStart.description: Time when db started executing the statement.

queryElapsedSec.description:
Elapsed time since db started executing the statement.  Note that if the statement has already completed
this will be larger than the elapsed time for executing the statement.

stateChange.description: Time when state changed for the statement.

stateChangeElapsedSec.description: Elapsed time since state changed for the statement.

waiting.description:
True if the statement is waiting (e.g. blocked due to lock being held by other session).

Present only for Postgres version earlier than 9.6

waitEvent.description:
Wait event name if backend is currently waiting, otherwise NULL.  For further information, go to:
https://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.6/static/monitoring-stats.html

Present only for Postgres version 9.6 and later.

waitEventType.description:
The type of event for which the backend is waiting, if any; otherwise NULL.  For further information, go to:
https://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.6/static/monitoring-stats.html

Present only for Postgres version 9.6 and later.

title: Result row returned from various functions that return information about current or past statements (e.g. {@link DbAdmin.getActiveStmts}).
